mask.offtopic_span: I just spent the whole afternoon repotting my succulent collection, and I swear my favorite zebra haworthia is finally putting out new baby offsets after months of looking totally dormant. I also found a tiny spotted ladybug crawling on one of the echeveria leaves, so I carefully moved it over to the mint planter on my windowsill where there are more aphids for it to eat. I even mixed up a new batch of well-draining cactus soil with extra perlite to make sure none of the plants get root rot now that the weather’s getting more humid.
